captured network error messages strip URLs and mask secrets via maskSecretsInText; debug log goes through sanitizeLogArgs; no attribution headers, paths or credentials touched

findings.title: Bare hostnames not masked in captured message
findings.problem: sanitizeMessage strips scheme URLs and secrets only; messages such as 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND internal-host' keep the hostname and are printed and logged.
findings.impact: Trigger is a DNS or connect failure; the host is the one the user configured and the output stays on their terminal, so exposure is low.
findings.recommendation: Also mask host or host:port tokens following getaddrinfo/connect error codes in sanitizeMessage.
